purpose: gnsslad13 (kernel q10jr6 / 0356, ioctl 153): power-on ladder, proven steps 1..12 then NEW step 13 (2 s console pause first): + L1 DSP on (0x18c73108) and DSP ROM okay poll (USRT D2AF3). Readback after every write, Wi-Fi guard before every access. Every step is rolled back at the end (saved original bits restored, vendor off order). Same guest/owned/undo as gnssstep (guest-gnssstep1.sh, owned-gnssstep1.json, payload-gnssstep-undo).
